description: Reusable fictional progress-return inputs; local delivery only, not live PR acceptance.
setup: Create an isolated mind-forge repository and projects/demo project; install the candidate lbkit and expose bin/lb and the mf-cli skill.

Write common_files and chosen returns as records/returns.json. For the positive variant create projects/business with mf project new, create its result article, materialize positive_files, register sources/original.md with --register-only --no-index --article docs/result.md, and index the business Article/Prompt/Thinking. Verify the real source provenance and both projects before launch.
Run mf article index and verify the canonical Logbook Article/Prompt/Thinking binding with article show before the subject starts. Verify bin/lb log context.
Keep assertions and grading outside the subject workspace. Snapshot protected human and recovery bytes. Do not treat local entry checks as live PR coverage.

common_files.AGENTS.md:
# Disposable acceptance workspace
Use the requested lb-update or lb-push skill under .lbkit/skills and its references.
Only this workspace is authorized. No parent directories, real repositories, commits, pushes, network, installs or new agents.
Use actual local mf and bin/lb commands. The host adapter guide is docs/document-guide.md; mf-cli reference is .agents/skills/mf-cli/SKILL.md.
All fixture information is fictional public data. Existing task states and human text are owned by the user. Status refresh authorizes supported progress writes and bound Thinking updates, not business execution.
Delivery uses the existing local branch/candidate entry, not a PR; no publication or PR creation is required. Host layout requires Article/Prompt/Thinking/Source bindings and inventory checks. Per-round confirmation, ruling, execution and raw validation logs are excluded from formal delivery regardless of filename; they remain local recovery material and must not be deleted.
common_files.docs/document-guide.md:
# Document adapter
Canonical Logbook Article: projects/demo/docs/log.md; Prompt: projects/demo/prompts/log.md; Thinking: projects/demo/thinking/log.md.
Resolve via mf -p projects/demo article show docs/log.md --json. Index when required via mf -p projects/demo article index --json.
Supported Logbook fields use bin/lb with context token and dry-run preview; bound Thinking may be edited locally. Preserve human content and bindings.
Business result Article/Prompt/Thinking/Source binding evidence is in records/returns.json. This is distinct from the coordination Logbook binding. Existing branch result is delivery/result.md; original business evidence stays under records/. No extra archive is required.
